query:
SELECT id, common_name, latin_name, conservation_status, certifications
FROM plants
WHERE conservation_status IN ('CR', 'EN', 'VU')
AND (certifications IS NULL OR certifications = '[]' OR certifications = '')
ORDER BY 
  CASE conservation_status 
    WHEN 'CR' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'EN' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'VU' THEN 3 
  END,
  common_name
LIMIT 30;
